title: API: a create that links to an entry returns both link flags true and adds no catalogue_part row
custom_preconds: Env https://sv10647.qa.shopview.com (S2 shop), location "Staging Heavy Duty". API calls are replayed from Chrome DevTools (Network tab: copy the request the screen sent, edit, resend) against sv10647api.qa.shopview.com with header X-Location-ID = the current location. Logged in as (a) Admin or a default Parts Manager. Location "Staging Heavy Duty" (X-Location-ID = Heavy Duty). Data: QAPL-LK1, stocked at "Staging Lethbridge" only; before the run note its Part Library description ("{library description}"). Take <cat> and <defaultBin> ids from the requests the New Inventory Part dialog loads. No DB access: values the handoff checks in the DB are verified through the API response, the UI and Part History instead.
custom_steps:
1. Go to Parts → Part Library and search QAPL-LK1.
  2. Send POST /api/inventory/parts/create {"partNumber":…,"description":…,"categoryId":"<cat>","vendorId":null,"manufacturerId":null,"quantity":0,"cost":"10.00","sellPrice":null,"min":0,"max":0,"gridLocation":null,"coreCharge":null,"environmentalCharge":null,"tags":["qa"],"bins":[{"id":"<defaultBin>","quantity":0,"isDefault":true}],"isFixedPrice":false} with "partNumber":"QAPL-LK1" and "description":"QA S7 other description".
  3. Search QAPL-LK1 in Parts → Part Library again.
  4. Search QAPL-LK1 on /parts/inventory at Heavy Duty.
  5. Switch to "Staging Lethbridge" and search QAPL-LK1 on /parts/inventory.
  6. Switch back to Heavy Duty. Cleanup: open the new part and click Delete Part (button_delete_part).
custom_expected:
1. Exactly one entry QAPL-LK1 with "{library description}".
  2. 201 with linkedToExistingEntry: true, libraryDescriptionKept: true, partNumber "QAPL-LK1" and description "{library description}" (not the typed one); the Lethbridge stock does not block the create.
  3. Still exactly one entry QAPL-LK1 (no second Part Library entry was added), description unchanged.
  4. The new row shows "{library description}".
  5. The Lethbridge part is unchanged and shows the same description.
  6. The part is deleted at once (no confirmation), the dialog closes and the list reloads without it.
